rationale: Both the bounded-sample finite-field and k-space Chern-Simons formalisms were correctly implemented from scratch for the paper's 8-site tight-binding model, confirming an insulating spectrum. However, quantitative agreement between the two methods could not be demonstrated: both estimators returned values at the numerical noise floor (~1e-3 to 1e-4) with near-zero correlation across the phase sweep. The paper's precision (differences ~1e-7 e²/ℏc) required larger clusters (L=4-7), cubic extrapolation, an 80³ k-mesh with globally smooth gauge, and inclusion of Kubo terms—all beyond the implemented scope. Core physics is present but headline claim unverified.
